objective: Review the split parser-payload validation helper for the non-executing direct command-path fixture, accept only the stricter parser-stub handoff validation, and select the next sidecar stage-plan materialization boundary without claiming native Verilator option support, command execution, RTL simulation, timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality.

review_decision.reason: The implementation closes the accepted hand-built parser_payload gap before boundary metadata is returned: the direct fixture rejects sidecar-owned fields first, then requires the exact parser-stub HANDOFF_FIELDS keyset, canonical identity values, strict positive state_count and step_count, normalized shape, non-empty mdir/top_module/provenance text, list[str] preserved build inputs, and non-empty non_claims.

Future parser-stub schema growth must be reviewed rather than silently accepted, and the implementation still returns reference-only sidecar_plan_boundary metadata instead of materializing a sidecar_stage_plan.
accepted_because: validation was split into an importable helper instead of growing the direct fixture past the script line guard
